story_log.title: Ben Shelton stuns Carlos Alcaraz in five-set thriller at US Open, wins at 3:33 a.m. ET—latest match in tournament history
story_log.development: Shelton defeated defending champion Alcaraz 6-7, 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-5 (closed with ace at 3:33 a.m. ET), latest match in US Open history per CBS Sports/ESPN. Alcaraz appeared to get sick during changeover per ESPN. All-American semifinal set—Shelton vs Tiafoe per ESPN/W_B_Rick. Game went to fifth set after Alcaraz forced decider per ESPN/ClutchPoints.

story_log.title: Frances Tiafoe completes biggest comeback of his career—down two sets to Alex Michelsen, rallies to reach US Open semifinals
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Tiafoe came back from two sets down to beat Michelsen in five per ESPN—biggest comeback of his career per ESPN. Emotional hug post-match between friends per ESPN/SportsCenter. Tiafoe: 'I know how much that hurts' per ESPN. Returns to US Open semis for third time per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Aaron Judge makes long-awaited return as Yankees clinch 34th consecutive winning season by beating Rockies
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Judge played six innings as planned in first game action since May 31 per CBS Sports. Yankees won 5-3 vs Rockies per ground truth, clinched 34th consecutive winning season (second-longest streak in MLB history—longest is Yankees' own 39 from 1926-64) per ClutchPoints. New game since yesterday.

story_log.title: Baker Mayfield and Buccaneers reach agreement on three-year, $165M extension—sides re-engaged after breaking off talks at camp
story_log.development: Mayfield agreed to 3yr/$165M extension ($55M per year) per Schefter/Pelissero/TomPelissero/AlbertBreer. Sides re-engaged late last week after breaking off talks at start of camp per AlbertBreer. Total deal 4yr/$205M: $50M this year, $50M next, $50M 2028, $55M 2029—total injury guarantee $150M per AlbertBreer. Signed through 2029 per Pelissero.

story_log.title: Elly De La Cruz throws 105.3 MPH bullet from center field to cut down Teoscar Hernández attempting inside-the-park HR—then demolishes 444-foot HR off Tarik Skubal
story_log.development: Elly threw out Teoscar at home on inside-the-park HR attempt with 105.3 MPH throw per TalkinBaseball—then hit 444-foot HR off Skubal per TalkinBaseball. Both plays in same inning per TalkinBaseball. Freak athleticism on display.

story_log.title: Aaron Donald will not travel to Australia for Rams' Week 1 opener vs 49ers—Rams want to give him more time to ramp up
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Donald will not travel to Melbourne for Thursday night opener, will be inactive per Schefter/RapSheet. Rams want more time to ramp up before much-anticipated return after two seasons of retirement per Schefter. Next chance to play: Sept. 23 home vs Giants on Monday Night Football per Schefter.

story_log.title: LIV Golf files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy—Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau reportedly free to leave as largest creditors
story_log.development: LIV Golf filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection per CBS Sports. Top stars like Rahm owed millions following exit of financial backers per CBS Sports—circuit aims to restructure. Rahm and DeChambeau reportedly free to leave as largest creditors per CBS Sports headline.

story_log.title: Brewers first team to 90 wins after Jackson Chourio ties it with two outs in 9th, Luis Lara walks it off in 10th
story_log.development: Chourio hit game-tying 2-run HR with Brewers down to final out per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Lara delivered walk-off hit in 10th per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Milwaukee first to 90 wins per TalkinBaseball. Wild sequence per TalkinBaseball.

story_log.title: Manny Machado ties game in 8th, Luis Campusano delivers go-ahead broken-bat single for Padres vs Nationals
story_log.development: Machado tied game in 8th inning per TalkinBaseball. Campusano came through with broken-bat single for lead per TalkinBaseball. Padres win 5-4 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Laz Montes hits 474-foot home run in his sixth MLB game—longest at T-Mobile Park during Statcast era, tied for longest in MLB this season
story_log.development: Montes hit 474-foot HR in 6th MLB game per TalkinBaseball—longest at T-Mobile Park in Statcast era, tied with Fernando Tatis Jr. for longest in MLB this season per TalkinBaseball. Mariners rookie moonshot.

story_log.title: Kazuma Okamoto becomes fifth Japanese-born player to reach 30 homers in a season—joins Matsui, Ohtani, Suzuki, Murakami
story_log.development: Okamoto hit 30th HR per TalkinBaseball/StatMuse—fifth Japanese-born player to reach 30 in season, joining Hideki Matsui, Shohei Ohtani, Seiya Suzuki, Munetaka Murakami per TalkinBaseball/StatMuse. Blue Jays milestone.

story_log.title: Josh Smith as a Blue Jay: 11 H, 5 HR, 7 RBI, 7 BB—only Kirk and Okamoto have more HRs than him since trade
story_log.development: Smith since joining Blue Jays: 11 H, 5 HR, 7 RBI, 7 BB per StatMuse. Only Kirk and Okamoto have more HRs for Toronto since he was traded per StatMuse. Hot start.

story_log.development: Pegula forced third set vs Emma Navarro per ESPN, then won 3-6, 6-4, 6-3 per ClutchPoints. Becomes only woman on tour to win 50 matches in one season per ESPN. Returns to US Open semis per ClutchPoints.

lead_story.research_notes: TIER 2 ELIMINATION/FINAL-DECIDING EVENT FLOOR applies: Tennis Grand Slam final has floor of STRONG SUPPORTING and cannot be demoted to Around the League.
